episodes.title: From Cult to Clean Eating | Rural Exchange Podcast
episodes.description:
Welcome back to another episode of the REX Daily Podcast on video!

In today's episode:
From cult to clean eating; meet the founder of Farm & Sea - Dan Nicholson
Dom talks with Dan Nicholson, founder of online real-food grocery platform Farm & Sea and former Gloriavale member, about growing up in the religious cult, working on its dairy farms from age eight and adapting to life outside Gloriavale.
